items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know the one you're talking about. Milneberg? Oh the West End Ruth.

ctx.x: We played at the Yacht Club too but not there.
I know the one you're talking about. Milneberg? Oh the West End Ruth.

West End. They used to have a group club. West End Ruth. Well that. We used to play there for Grunewald, you see. And he looked like he didn't like us for the next season, you see. He wore it for a Mexican band. He used that for novelty. Well he hired the Mexican band and it was a flop. They didn't make no success at all with that, you see. So he wished he had to kept the Maple Leaf band there. So the Maple Leaf band broke up after that because we didn't get that job. We thought we were sticking together because…
